'''Uma Laszlo''' is an [[Engineers|Odyssey Engineer]] based at '''Laszlo's Resolve''' in the '''Xuane''' system. She specialises in combat-oriented suit protection, shield recovery, and handheld-weapon performance.<ref name="inara-uma">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/32/ Uma Laszlo — Engineer], INARA; current access, location, and modification record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

Laszlo is reached through [[Wellington Beck]] and is the terminal Engineer in that referral branch.

Laszlo's Resolve is a surface Engineer base on Xuane A 3, approximately 306 Ls from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-laszlo-resolve">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/275530/ Laszlo's Resolve — Station], INARA; current facility and location record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Access requirements ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Stage
! Requirement
|-
| Discovery
| Receive a referral from [[Wellington Beck]] after providing him with '''5 Insight Entertainment Suites'''.
|-
| Unlock
| Reach '''Unfriendly reputation or lower''' with Sirius Corporation.
|}

Laszlo's final requirement is unusual because it requires negative faction reputation: Neutral, Cordial, Friendly, and Allied do not satisfy it. The complete ordered process, including the consequences of lowering Sirius Corporation reputation, belongs to [[Unlocking Uma Laszlo]].<ref name="inara-uma" /><ref name="inara-beck">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/30/ Wellington Beck — Engineer], INARA; current referral requirement. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

{{Field note|INARA reports that station services may not appear immediately after the workshop is unlocked. Relogging should make them available.<ref name="inara-uma" />}}

== Odyssey Engineering ==

Laszlo installs individual modifications into available suit and handheld-weapon modification slots. Her services do not use the Grade 1–5 Engineer-reputation progression, blueprint rolls, Experimental Effects, or Remote Engineering used for ship modules. Equipment grade and modification-slot availability are handled through the wider [[Odyssey Engineering]] system.

== Engineering services ==

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Modification
! Equipment
! Purpose
|-
| Damage Resistance
| Suit
| Reduces kinetic, thermal, plasma, and explosive damage taken.
|-
| Faster Shield Regen
| Suit
| Increases personal-shield regeneration rate.
|-
| Headshot Damage
| Handheld weapon
| Increases damage inflicted by headshots; recipes differ by manufacturer.
|-
| Reload Speed
| Handheld weapon
| Shortens weapon reload time.
|-
| Stowed Reloading
| Handheld weapon
| Automatically reloads the weapon while it is stowed.
|}

These five modification types are available once Laszlo is unlocked, subject to compatible equipment, an open modification slot, and the required Odyssey materials and credits.<ref name="inara-uma" /> Their complete recipes and cross-Engineer availability belong to [[Odyssey Engineer Modifications]].

== Referral position ==

Laszlo is the endpoint of the Wellington Beck branch and does not provide a direct referral to another Engineer.

Wellington Beck
└── Uma Laszlo
</pre>
